meta.title: 上镜技巧‖拍照时的眼神管理✨3步速成

scenes.title_cn: 看镜头时：看镜头时脸部完全放松会显得…
scenes.title_en: Looking at the lens: a fully relaxed face …
sentences: 看镜头时脸部完全放松会显得无神。
A fully relaxed face looks lifeless when looking at the lens.
lifeless（无神）
眉毛稍微用力会显得更加舒展。
Slightly engaging the brows looks more open and bright.
engage the brows（眉毛用力）
scenes.speak: A fully relaxed face looks lifeless when looking at the lens. Slightly engaging the brows looks more open and bright.

scenes.title_cn: 不看镜头时：不看镜头时为了避免眼白过…
scenes.title_en: Looking away: to avoid too much sclera, ke…
scenes.context: 视线夹角不超45度+反向看。
sentences: 不看镜头时，眼睛视线要保证与镜头的夹角不超过45度。
When looking away, keep the eye-to-lens angle within 45 degrees.
45-degree angle（45度夹角）
脸右转就向左看，脸左转就向右看。
Face right and look left; face left and look right.
opposite gaze（反向看）
scenes.speak: When looking away, keep the eye-to-lens angle within 45 degrees. Face right and look left; face left and look right.

scenes.title_cn: 抬头低头与微笑：抬头要垂眸，低头就抬…
scenes.title_en: Chin and smile: when you tilt up, lower yo…
scenes.context: 抬头垂眸低头抬眼+月牙眼笑。
sentences: 抬头要垂眸，低头就抬眼。
Tilt up and lower your gaze; tilt down and raise it.
opposite gaze rule（反向眼神）
露出微笑时呲牙咧嘴会显假。
Baring your teeth when smiling looks fake.
baring teeth（呲牙咧嘴）
想象眼睛是一个小月牙，才会更真实。
Imagine your eyes as crescent moons for a genuine look.
crescent moon eyes（月牙眼）
scenes.speak: Tilt up and lower your gaze; tilt down and raise it. Baring your teeth when smiling looks fake. Imagine your eyes as crescent moons for a genuine look.

practice: Slightly engage the brows to open the look.
Keep the eye-to-lens angle within 45 degrees.
Face right and look left; face left and look right.
Tilt up and lower your gaze; tilt down and raise it.
pitfalls: Let the face go fully relaxed.
Slightly engage the brows for a bright look.
Keep the eye-to-lens angle within 45 degrees.
Turn eyes the same way as the face.
脸右转看左，脸左转看右。
Imagine crescent-moon eyes for a real smile.
呲牙咧嘴显假，月牙眼才真。
shifts: 用 lifeless（无神）、engage the brows（眉毛发力）、sclera（眼白）
用 45-degree angle（45度夹角）、opposite gaze（反向看）
用 baring teeth（呲牙咧嘴）、crescent-moon eyes（月牙眼）、genuine（真实）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：看镜头、脸部完全放松、无神、眉毛稍微用力、舒展、不看镜头、眼白过多、视线夹角、不超过45度、脸右转左看、脸左转右看、抬头垂眸、低头抬眼、呲牙咧嘴显假、小月牙、真实、显假等。
